rules.name: drink-skipped
rules.why: life under the drink line with hostiles near and potions in the belt, and the choice is not the reflex (survive): the monitor row potion-not-drunk

rules.name: no-kit-stays-in-field
rules.why: the hero keeps a quest step or the level sweep going in the field with an empty belt (soft row; farming gold when broke is the way out and is not scored)

rules.name: claim-waits-while-leveling
rules.why: a quest reward waits and the field is quiet, and the hero keeps working in the field: the reward (skill point, stat, gold) idles (soft row economy-stall; model of the monitor, U)

rules.name: poverty-trip-spiral
rules.why: town trips for a refill the purse cannot pay while recovery runs: the Questy poverty spiral (150 trips, median gold 35, 136 'no withdrawal for the shop'; soft row economy-stall, model of the monitor, U)

rules.name: quest-asks-while-refused
rules.why: the quest step is asked again while its typed refusal stands and nothing it waits on changed: the refusal storm (soft row; Questy had 296 refusals among 321 failed actions, review 2026-11-25 section 3.4; model of the monitor, U)

rules.name: refused-step-no-xp
rules.why: the refused quest step is asked again for ten minutes or more and the hero gains no XP: the silent stretch of the Questy log (hard row xp-frozen; model of the monitor, U)
